time.expression: Subexponential time in log N, with N=|Cl(O)|

space.expression: Polynomial quantum space; subexponential classical precomputation/storage

notes: The checked analysis assumes the class group is cyclic. It uses classical subexponential precomputation and storage, but polynomial quantum space for the online action-inversion computation. Extension to non-cyclic groups is conjectured in Section 3.1.

extra.application: CRS and CSIDH CM group-action inversion
